pages.title: Drumhearts
pages.text:
The Drumhearts kept the beat under the whole sky. Spirit Pulse — power as rhythm before it was a number — ran from their drums along the lattice to every tribe.

The orphan engines you find still keep their time. Listen before you feed one.

pages.title: Spark Strand
pages.text:
*The drum is not loud. The drum is steady. Be the drum.*

Seated. The Drumhearts answer when this Post hums.

pages.title: Their camp
pages.text:
The Drumhearts keep a camp in the March steppe: huts, a fire, a Tribe Hearth, a Fire totem, a banner, four Kin — an Elder, a Drummer, a Hunter and a Weaver — and an Ember Horn.

Their hearth favours copper, charged Pulse Cells, Bone Chimes. Their Elder trades Bone Chimes, Pulse Cells, and the Ember Horn. At Voice standing they press the tribe's Mark into your hand. Camps already generated in an old world keep the layout they spawned with.
